message: Now the R1 aggregation: parse state abbreviations from the metro names, unpivot into (state, metro, report type), and total all report types per state.

sql:
WITH idt AS (
  SELECT column1 AS metro, CAST(replace(column3, ',', '') AS BIGINT) AS reports
  FROM "2024_CSN_Metropolitan_Areas_Identity_Theft_Reports"
  WHERE column3 IS NOT NULL AND column3 <> '# of Reports'
),
frd AS (
  SELECT column1 AS metro, CAST(replace(column3, ',', '') AS BIGINT) AS reports
  FROM "2024_CSN_Metropolitan_Areas_Fraud_and_Other_Reports"
  WHERE column3 IS NOT NULL AND column3 <> '# of Reports'
),
pairs AS (
  SELECT metro, reports, 'identity_theft' AS rtype FROM idt
  UNION ALL
  SELECT metro, reports, 'fraud_and_other' AS rtype FROM frd
),
unpivot AS (
  SELECT regexp_extract(metro, ', ([A-Z]{2}(?:-[A-Z]{2})*) ', 1) AS state_codes_raw,
         reports, rtype, metro
  FROM pairs
),
states AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT trim(s.state_code) AS state_code
  FROM (SELECT regexp_extract(metro, ', ([A-Z]{2}(?:-[A-Z]{2})*) ', 1) AS state_codes_raw FROM pairs) x,
  LATERAL regexp_split_to_table(state_codes_raw, '-') AS s(state_code)
),
state_totals AS (
  SELECT st.state_code, sum(p.reports) AS total_reports_all_types
  FROM states st
  JOIN unpivot p ON position(st.state_code || '-' IN p.state_codes_raw || '-') > 0
  GROUP BY st.state_code
)
SELECT state_code, total_reports_all_types
FROM state_totals
ORDER BY total_reports_all_types DESC
